claims.evidence: The witness report explicitly identifies the PS5 logo on the spines and lists PS5-specific titles like FC 25 and God of War Ragnarok.
The witness only observed the cases; the condition of the actual discs was not shown.
The witness report does not mention factory shrink-wrap or seals on any of the cases.

risks.risk: The cases may be empty or contain the wrong discs.
risks.proof: A continuous video clip showing the seller opening every case to reveal the disc inside.

risks.risk: The discs may be heavily scratched or unreadable.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the data side (underside) of each individual disc.

risks.risk: Games may be from a region that restricts DLC or online play in Nigeria.
risks.proof: Photos of the back of the cases showing the region rating (ESRB, PEGI, etc.) and the region globe icon.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the least desirable region.

proof_requests: Video of all 21 cases being opened to show the discs.
Photos of the underside of the discs for FC 25, Elden Ring, and GTA V.
Photos of the back of the cases to confirm region codes.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the titles and platform as PS5, allowing for a baseline valuation at the worst-case scenario of empty or damaged goods despite the seller's incorrect description.
